fusions.name: Shaken Spray
fusions.desc: Shakes the water out of your hair in a cone 3.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 water damage and leaving each target [Soaked] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unruffling Stroke
fusions.desc: Draws an oiled braid down a target up to 4 tiles away for 13 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Damped] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Oiled Down
fusions.desc: Works preen oil through every strand: for 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Strider's Tread

riders.text: you skate over it faster than over ground
and blows slide off you while you are on it
and the water under you mends you

fusions.desc: Fine oiled hairs on your feet hold you up on the surface: you walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster on it, from silver you have 8% more dodge chance on it, and from gold your health recovers 15% faster on it.
